bugs_found: apply_fee mixes Decimal with float: when computed fee is within min/max bounds, return a - fee raises TypeError at runtime
apply_fee converts monetary values to float, causing precision loss and possible incorrect fees/balances
transfer does not coerce/validate amount as Decimal; float amounts can raise TypeError or introduce unsafe mixed numeric behavior
